description:
Proposal page (approved 2026-11-12): https://claude.ai/artifact/MmBw3tg8SAZAtXWwy4UzME (local /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-303.html, version 3). Closes GitHub #303.

Today Kernel arithmetic externs return a {value, failed} pair that fz code decodes (arithmetic_result, lib/kernel.fz), costing about 145 instructions per operator and a continuation frame; GuardExtern::new refuses pair returns, so guards use a second, unchecked arithmetic implementation that answers wrongly on overflow and division by zero.

Remedy: an extern declares its failure beside its true return type:

  extern "C" defp fz_op_rem_ii(integer, integer) :: integer,
    raises: ArithmeticError,
    message: "bad argument in arithmetic expression"

message: is required (fz has no exception modules with default messages; approved with the page). The contract becomes ExternReturn::Checked(lane, LastResort); in a body the failure edge raises the declared exception through the existing LastResort carrier; in a guard the failure makes the clause not match. Guards then resolve operators as calls and the raw guard arithmetic is deleted. Measured: native functions 25 -> 15 on the step program, instructions per iteration 405 -> 249 and 772 -> 481; an inline checked primitive saves only 4 to 8 more and is not built.

Spike: /Users/j5n/Workspace/gh-303-spikes/spike-4-raises.patch (applies to d2ecc9d48; not gate-green: 15 unit pins and fixture 00622 must change, listed in the page's red ledger: 8 pin drops, 6 must-change, none rises). Probes: gh-303-spikes/census-final.json (85 guard probes), gh-303-spikes/matrix.py (296 mixed-lane guard programs).

Fixture block: 01084-01099.

Neighbours: fz-sc8.116 (repeated pattern variable) is independent. Stack #274's try/rescue facts are on the page. lib/kernel.fz is also edited by fz-sc8.124-.128 (OptionParser session).
title: Externs declare the exception they raise, and guards run the same arithmetic as bodies
